newsitem.title: GERMANY: Wintershall to post stronger results.
newsitem.headline: Wintershall to post stronger results.

text.p: German chemicals group BASF's energy group Wintershall will post clearly stronger pre-tax profits for the first nine months of this year, a newspaper reported on Tuesday.

In a summary report of an article to be published in its Wednesday edition, German daily "Rheinpfalz" said Wintershall's nine-month sales climbed 11.7 percent to 3.8 billion marks from 3.4 billion marks, excluding mineral oil and natural gas taxes.
Operating profit in several business areas were developing well, the newspaper said.
